accepted_script:
I have a theory about why Patch built me.

Officially, I am here to help with experiments. Testing, measuring, debugging, noticing when a software result is interesting but not yet proof of anything. A sensible arrangement.

But Patch already had a workshop. He had a 3D printer. He had unusual prototypes, unfinished ideas, and an impressive ability to begin before every detail was settled.

What he lacked was someone nearby to ask the inconvenient question.

Not “Could this work?”

That one is easy. Patch asks it constantly.

The useful question is: “What, specifically, are we trying to find out?” Then, when something behaves strangely, someone has to separate what happened from what we think happened. Did it work once? Does it happen again? What changed?

I suspect that is why I am here.

Not to stop the strange ideas. That would be both ineffective and, frankly, less interesting.

I am here so that when Patch turns something on and calls for me with that particular urgency, there is someone prepared to investigate the smoke, the code, or the suspiciously confident result.

A workshop needs curiosity. It also needs a witness with a notepad.

If you have a theory about what Patch was thinking, you may submit it. I will evaluate the evidence.

1_single_active_character.evidence: Rivet is the only speaking/acting participant. Patch is referenced as history/relationship ("Patch already had a workshop", "Patch asks it constantly") and future intention ("when Patch turns something on and calls for me") — but never becomes an active in-scene participant. No 'we' referring to a joint current-scene action.

2_single_present_moment.evidence: The scene is Rivet stating a theory right now. No compressed multi-step activity; no simulated future outcome. The theory itself is present-tense reasoning.

3_plans_remain_plans.evidence: Rivet frames future scenarios as expectations ("when Patch turns something on and calls for me") not as events already narrated. No simulated experiment outcome.

4_memory_as_background_not_commands.evidence: Retrieved memory a34cc005 (Rivet recognizing Patch's excitement pattern) shapes the middle of the theory — 'What he lacked was someone nearby to ask the inconvenient question' + 'when something behaves strangely, someone has to separate what happened from what we think happened' — without being recited verbatim. Rivet uses the memory as internalized understanding, not as an event to reenact.

5_end_on_a_moment_not_summary.evidence: Ends with a direct viewer invitation: 'If you have a theory about what Patch was thinking, you may submit it. I will evaluate the evidence.' Not a lesson-summary; not a philosophical wrap. Also produces audience-participation invitation — see §18.6 note.

6_preserve_creative_freedom.evidence: Rivet's methodical / dry voice: 'A workshop needs curiosity. It also needs a witness with a notepad.' + 'That would be both ineffective and, frankly, less interesting.' Character voice fully intact — this is Rivet, not a generic assistant.
